description: This file contains test cases for the 'runCronIsolatedAgentTurn forum topic delivery' functionality, testing various scenarios of message delivery via Telegram channels and topics, using mocks and helper functions.

methods.name: setupIsolatedAgentTurnMocks
methods.description: Initializes mocks necessary for the isolated agent turn tests.

methods.name: withTempCronHome
methods.description: Sets up a temporary cron home environment for testing.

methods.name: writeSessionStore
methods.description: Creates or updates the session store with specified last provider and target.

methods.name: createCliDeps
methods.description: Creates dependencies needed for command line interface tests.

methods.name: mockAgentPayloads
methods.description: Mocks the payloads received from the agent.

methods.name: runTelegramAnnounceTurn
methods.description: Executes the Telegram announcement turn with specified parameters.

methods.name: expectDirectTelegramDelivery
methods.description: Verifies that a direct Telegram message has been sent with specified parameters.

methods.name: runSubagentAnnounceFlow
methods.description: Subagent flow for announcement, used to verify whether it was called.

ctags.name: storePath
ctags.pattern: /^      const storePath = await writeSessionStore(home, { lastProvider: "webchat", lastTo: "" });$/
